title: Government Plans to Export Imported Sugar at a Loss
excerpt: The federal government is considering selling 108,000 tons of sugar imported last year at about Rs. 110 per kg.
body_html:
The federal government is reportedly planning to export 108,000 tons of sugar that was imported during the previous year. According to available details, the authorities are considering selling the stock at approximately Rs. 110 per kilogram.

This planned move is expected to result in a massive financial loss for the state, as the selling price sits well below the costs associated with the initial import.
